name: AFortAIPawn::GetSurfaceTypeFromHit
notes: Starts from surface 0. Resolves the hit actor (weak pointer at hit+0x6c), casts it to FortDamageableActorInterface (class 0x1428c9e00) and reads its surface through slot 0x10. Without that interface it falls back to the hit component (weak pointer at hit+0x64) and then to 0x17 when the distance qualifies. Finally remaps 1/0xe, 2/0xf, 3/0x10 and defaults to 0xc when the hit matches the sentinel pair at +0x7c/+0x80. Interface cast helper 0x142ec9900 is named by role only.
